ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Eventlog Clear
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of known powershell cmdlets such as "Clear-EventLog" to clear the Windows event logs Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Clear\\-EventLog\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-EventLog\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Limit\\-EventLog\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Clear\\-WinEvent\\ .*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Eventing\\\.Reader\\\.EventLogSession.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ClearLog.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Diagnostics\\\.EventLog.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Clear.*")))
